_about: Checked fixes to Yahoo's daily closes. The pipeline re-applies them after every download (datapipe/prices.py apply_corrections),
so a new Yahoo download can't undo them. 'close' is the right close (split-adjusted, like Yahoo's), 'replaces' is the wrong
value Yahoo shows; a fix is only applied while Yahoo still shows that value, otherwise it is skipped and reported in meta.json.
The adjusted close on that day is scaled by the same ratio as the close.
checkedFlatRuns: runs of identical closes a person has checked and found genuine, so the stuck-price check stops reporting them.
